title: The New Flour

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The mill's been grinding all week: the first flour from this year's wheat! Smell it.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: For Harvest Home I'll bake the biggest loaf you've ever seen. Will you weigh the flour?

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Add scoops of flour until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! The harvest loaf is under way.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: From Mrs. Hannah's fields, through the mill, into my bakery. And soon onto everyone's plate.

journal_line: I weighed the new flour for the harvest loaf with Mr. Tobias.
